== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Pariana is a member of the [[Abidan]] and was formerly the final [[Abidan]] stationed in [[Sector]] Ninety-[[Eight]] of a nameless world. Physically, she is distinct from standard humans, standing three meters tall with golden skin and a bald head. Her abilities involve manipulating [[Way|the Way]] to create protective barriers, containment fields, and complex formations using runes and symbols. During her service in [[Sector]] Ninety-[[Eight]], she demonstrated the ability to use a [[Presence]]—a silver mass located within her mind—to restore herself and others. Following the [[Collapse]], she developed an idolization of [[Judge Suriel|Suriel]]. Her military career progressed from her service in [[Sector]] Ninety-[[Eight]] to a promotion as a two-star [[Titan]], where she specialized in the maintenance and construction of formations.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Pariana possesses a tall, golden body. She is outfitted in white-plated armor.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|As a member of the [[Second Division]], her specialty has never been violence. She serves as the designer of the formations.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Pariana can [[construct]] containment fields. Her restrictive symbols utilize lines in her gold, the pure blue of [[Way|the Way]], and pink [[Silverlords|Silverlord]] [[Script|script]].}}

== Underlord ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Pariana is a tall, golden-bodied [[Abidan]] and [[Titan]]. Clad in white-plated armor, she possesses a distinct [[Presence]]. Rather than focusing on violence, her true specialty lies in her role as the designer of the formations.}}
